name: Microsoft La Muela datacenter campus (Aragón)
summary: Planned Microsoft datacenter campus at the Centrovía industrial estate in La Muela, west of Zaragoza, the largest by area and investment of the three campuses in Microsoft's Aragón plan. The site was declared of general interest in late 2023. The regional plan (PIGA Región MSFT), given initial approval in November 2025, assigns it 146 hectares and about EUR 2.18 billion, with 50 MW secured for a first phase and up to 300 MW sought later through a new substation. The plan still lacked final approval in August 2026, and a modified version went out for public comment in July 2026. Forbes reported first operation was expected from 2030.

location.note: Nominatim point for the Polígono Industrial Centrovía in La Muela, which sources name as the site area (the campus involves an expansion of the estate); the 146-hectare boundary is not published in the sources.

milestones.note: Vozpópuli and EFE report that the Centrovía site in La Muela received general-interest status in the final months of 2023.
Initial approval of the PIGA Región MSFT plan covering La Muela, Villamayor de Gállego and Zaragoza, opening a public information period.
A modification of the PIGA was published in the Boletín Oficial de Aragón for public comment.
Forbes reported the first phase was expected to operate from 2030.

power_sources.description: Grid supply through a new substation (named Plaza) starting at 132 kV with a later upgrade to 220 kV.
